environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as a systemd service under the 'webapp' user. The instance has IAM role with S3 and SSM access. Flask app served directly via Gunicorn on port 8080 behind an AWS ALB with no additional rule groups. The container/host filesystem is standard ext4 with no mandatory access control. exiftool 12.40 and ImageMagick 7.1.0 are installed system-wide.

config.alb_rules: default forward action only, no WAF WebACL attached
